rationale: Planner software input bounds, not empirical event-size distributions or approval of extrapolated prices. Existing rates, formulas, fixed 4x6 m stage, 60 m2 circulation, hours and policies remain unchanged.
budget_policy: Any finite positive spending limit is accepted by the calculator (subject to existing numerical safety limits); LKR 100000 is valid. Never scale expenses to make a budget feasible.
model_policy: Preserve frozen XGBoost/GAT support checks. Withhold predictions outside original training feature ranges. Do not train or regenerate records.
limitations: Wedding and Corporate only; not all event archetypes
Extrapolated generic-profile costs are not validated small-event or large-event market quotations
The fixed stage and circulation assumptions may make tiny venues infeasible
Low-cost or no-stage profiles need separate scoped evidence and rules
